summary: Frontend-only verification of the seed-created demo student logins on the RidePact mobile app (Expo web preview at https://typography-74.preview.emergentagent.com, mobile viewport 375x667). All 5 requested checks passed. (1) Welcome screen renders and 'I already have an account' [data-testid=welcome-signin] navigates to /signin. (2) Sign-in with student@university.edu / Student@12345 via [signin-email], [signin-password], [signin-submit] lands on /home with no signin-error and no red screen — confirms the seed produced a usable pre-verified account. (3) Home renders correctly: title 'Home', notification bell [home-notifications], YOUR UPCOMING RIDE empty-state card ([home-empty], [home-create-ride], [home-notify-me]) with '6 students looking for Fall Study Break' hint, and UPCOMING BREAKS preview listing Fall Study Break / TEST_Break_jz63fy / Thanksgiving Recess. (4) Bottom tabs all navigate: [tab-find] -> /find shows 'Find Rides' with populated browse-list (multiple browse-card-* rows with flight/depart/vehicle/price); [tab-create-button] (center FAB) -> /create shows the full 'Create Ride' form (Find Riders/Invite Friends mode, Direction ATL, Airport picker, Flight Departure Time, Travel Date, Airline & Flight # input, Bags, submit); [tab-profile] -> /profile shows 'Alex Rivera', email 'student@university.edu', username, payment handle, Ride History, and 'Log Out' button [profile-logout]. (5) [profile-logout] returns to /welcome; second seeded student taylor@university.edu / Student@12345 signs in successfully to /home with no error. No red screen, no PAGEERROR during the authenticated flow, zero signin errors. Only console noise observed is a benign WebSocket 403 for /api/socket.io (pre-existing, unrelated to the seed).
critical_code_review_comments: Seed-driven login works end-to-end on the mobile Expo web preview for both demo accounts (student@university.edu and taylor@university.edu). No mobile code changes are needed for this feature.

Non-blocking: a WebSocket handshake against wss://.../api/socket.io returns 403 in the browser console on every page. It does not affect login/home/find/create/profile flows, but if realtime chat is expected to work in the web preview, the socket.io ingress path may need review.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5: welcome->signin nav, student signin+home, home content, bottom tabs Find/Create/Profile, taylor signin)

seed_data_creation: None created by testing agent. Verified the two pre-existing seeded accounts from `cd backend && npm run seed`: student@university.edu / Student@12345 (Alex Rivera) and taylor@university.edu / Student@12345 (Taylor Kim).

rca_of_issue: N/A — no bug. Feature-verification pass for the seed script. Both seeded demo students authenticate via POST /api/auth/login (200) and drive the full mobile UI (home/find/create/profile/logout) without errors.
